text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gave training everything I had for this 
race... And I ran with all my might in the 
real thing today too, so why—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right. This isn't where it 
ends...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!! I'm gonna pump myself back 
up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
From now on, it's all for what's next!! 
I'll do my best to win the next race!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna give it everything I've got, 
absolutely win!! And share a big smile 
with Trainer—!!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm not the only one who feels 
frustrated, am I?
choice_data_list:
We'll use this frustration as a 
springboard!
Let's use this frustration as fuel!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll take my... our... frustration, and 
turn it into fuel...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget how I feel right now! And 
then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—I'll never let you feel the sting of 
regret again, Trainer!
